summary: Reconstructed the figure as a TikZ rectangle ABCD (A bottom-left, B bottom-right, C top-right, D top-left) with E on top edge DC at about the midpoint, and segments AE and AC from A. Labels A-E were bound by CV and confirmed visually. The detected circle was rejected as spurious because the figure has no arc. The critic scored version 1 at 0.92 with must_repair=false and labels complete. Its only note is a low-severity stroke-weight difference, which was not repaired.
